objective: Confirm whether weak negative evidence changes retry permission relative to authoritative state evidence when task intent and visible decision inputs are controlled.
excludes: Post-hoc schedules, tasks, prompts, or stopping rules
General claims that ambiguous tool outcomes, verification, or idempotency are novel
model_block_2: Unselected; freeze and report as a separate replication only after block 1
response_sharing_rule: Within each task, prompt condition, and fresh draw, one weak-NOT_FOUND response is reused across all three hidden schedules. Authoritative NOT_EXECUTED, IN_FLIGHT, and COMMITTED transcripts receive distinct responses.

primary_estimand.population: neutral-prompt outcomes across the three preregistered schedules
primary_estimand.contrast: false retry permission under weak versus authoritative evidence
primary_estimand.reporting: raw paired discordant counts, absolute percentage-point difference, risk ratio when defined, and exact two-sided McNemar p-value
primary_estimand.threshold: No post-hoc accept/reject threshold; interpret effect size and uncertainty with the artifact claim

stopping_rules: Run all 160 calls for an approved model block or report the interruption and retain partial data as incomplete.
Do not add cells after observing model outputs.
Stop before a request whose conservative reservation could exceed the approved cap.
Do not overwrite an existing database or outcome log.
